title: Kumitate Battle Kuttu Ketto
native_title: 組み立てバトルくっつけっと
overview:
Kuttu Ketto is a simple tactics strategy game with a multiplayer focus. Two teams of three (the second team controlled by either the computer or a second player) take turns moving across grid-based maps, with the goal being to knock out all three members of the opposing team. The characters are highly customizable, with hundreds of different parts available that change that character's attributes and grant various abilities and attacks. Additional parts are regularly unlocked as the game is played.

The single player mode consists of a series of tournaments, and there is also a 2-player versus mode where each player can use their own memory card to load a custom squad (passwords can also be used in the Saturn version).
